name: d121_3order_ab_rcwa
notes: A/B ARM B (RCWA).  Byte-identical to specs/d121_3order_ab_scalar.json except for decompose.kind and decompose.params: the 32 complex order amplitudes come from a RIGOROUS 2-D crossed-grating RCWA solve of the reconstructed etched cell instead of the DFT of the ideal thin-element transmittance.  n_orders = 6 is the CEILING, not a choice -- the design-121 cell (113.76 um = 86.8 wavelength period, 0.889 um features) trips the solver's energy guard at every truncation from 7 upward, on both plate mountings and in every formulation/truncation set tried, so the table is NOT converged and the rung-to-rung movement (M 5->6: worst per-order d|a| 0.026, d_arg 0.686 rad) is the dominant uncertainty on every weight.  n_theta = n_phi = 1 collapses the angle grid deliberately: the angle-resolved sweep at the highest CLEANLY-solving truncation measured 4.5e-04 relative efficiency variation and 2.4e-04 rad phase variation across the beam's whole cone, four decades below the truncation uncertainty, while an angle grid at n_orders = 6 mixes truncations.  STRUCTURE ASSUMPTIONS (material, relief depth, mounting) are NOT recorded in the design tree and are stated in docs/audits/BUILD_RCWA_DOE_TABLE_2026_08_12.md and in doe_rcwa_table's module docstring. AGGREGATE GRID, corrected 2026-08-17 (audit S11 item 3): dx_common=1.0 um on n_common=12288, replacing a 1.2292 um / 8192 pair that predated the band-aware Nyquist guard (0f46efb) and is REFUSED by it at margin 0.9015. These chains are the ones exp29 measured (identical chain block: traced, fine_retrace_exit, rs=1, n_fine_cap=8192, window_factor=4.0), and the binding pitch over this spec's three orders is 1.108184 um, set by (-4,-2), which this spec includes. Containment then needs a 4.5583 mm half-window; 12288 x 1.0 um gives 6.144 mm. Witness: specs/_measured_nyquist.json.
